item.description:
### New
- The Mac menu's Queue names each waiting job and its workflow once GitHub has said which job it is. When jobs went to hosted runners because every slot was busy, a button allows one more job at once: the app pauses new jobs, waits for the running ones to finish, and comes back with the extra slot, or goes back to the earlier setting if it can't. - The Mac menu has Now, Queue and History tabs. Queue lists the jobs waiting for this Mac and how long each has waited, and says when jobs went to hosted runners in the last hour because every slot was busy. History shows the last 12 hours as a bar per hour, with the latest jobs, all or only failed. `connect --events` adds `queue` and `spilled` to `waiting` and `state`. - The menu shows how long each running job has taken and about how long it has left, based on its usual time on this Mac. It also lists the last five jobs this Mac ran, with a link to each on GitHub and a total for the day, and lets you pause new jobs for an hour, four hours or until tomorrow morning. - The Mac menu shows a row for each job slot, free ones included, with a bar against each job's usual time, and this Mac's CPU and memory while the menu is open. `connect --events` says how many slots the machine has in `state`. - The Mac menu and `connect --events` now say how many jobs are waiting for a slot on this machine.
### Fixes and improvements
- New installs connect to https://app.relayrunner.dev and link to relayrunner.dev. Machines already connected keep their saved server, https://app.relayrunner.app, which keeps working.
Includes the relayrunner CLI 0.14.0.
